SavedPhrase.title: SavedPhrase
SavedPhrase.description: A user-saved reading passage or phrase with translation, IPA phonetics, accent tip, and pronunciation mastery score.

sourceText.description: Original phrase or reading passage text.

translatedText.description: Translated text in the user's target/native language.

sourceLanguage.description: BCP-47 or language code of the source phrase (e.g., en-US, es-ES).

targetLanguage.description: BCP-47 or language code of the translation.

ipa.description: Phonetic IPA transcription and stress breakdown.

accentTip.description: Key accent and articulation note for the phrase.

lastScore.description: Most recent pronunciation score from 0 to 100.

practiceCount.description: Number of pronunciation practice attempts completed.

PracticeSession.title: PracticeSession
PracticeSession.description: A recorded pronunciation and accent analysis session for language learning progress tracking.

phraseText.description: Target phrase practiced by the user.

targetLanguage.description: Target accent/language code (e.g., en-US, en-GB, fr-FR).

recognizedTranscript.description: Speech-to-Text recognized transcript of what the user spoke.

coachSummary.description: Actionable AI pronunciation and accent correction summary.

speechEngine.description: Speech engine used (e.g., Google Cloud STT + Gemini, Gemini Audio).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when session was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/phrases/{phraseId}.description: User-owned saved reading phrases, translations, and phonetic cards.

/users/{userId}/practiceSessions/{sessio.description: User-owned pronunciation and accent coaching history.
